title: Hold granularity: after the first wave, keep exactly two held units, or exactly one, and count new surface waves over 10,000 ticks

predictions.model: F1 B · any held surface unit blocks
predictions.expects: no new surface wave in either arm while the held units stay (their countdowns are 20,000+)

predictions.model: F1 C · the gate opens at one held unit
predictions.expects: arm one: a wave within ~1,500 ticks of the release; arm two: nothing
a wave from another entry in both arms

kill_criterion: arm one must differ from arm two in at least two of three replicate pairs; a wave in both kills B and C, a wave in neither kills A and C
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
drop a replicate whose first wave had fewer than three surface units (no release possible)
drop a replicate in which a held unit left before the budget ended
